sloka: मम लालस्य मानस्य सुतार्थम् नास्ति वै सुखम् ।तदर्थम् हयमेधेन यक्ष्ह्यामि इति मतिर् मम ॥१-८-८॥
transliteration: mama lālasya mānasya sutārtham nāsti vai sukham ।tadartham hayamedhena yakṣhyāmi iti matir mama ॥1-8-8॥

translations.english: There is no happiness for one who has no son. This is the cause of my intense suffering. Therefore, I have made up my mind to perform a horsesacrifice.
